reasons: PRICE_N_LOW_RECLAIM_UP reuses a prior rolling-high breakout predicate as a prerequisite and therefore reopens a closed high-breakout lineage instead of defining an independent trigger family.
PRICE_N_LOW_RECLAIM_UP is mislabeled: the proposed t0 does not contain a discrete reclaim transition of the rolling low.
VOLUME_SURGE_BREAKOUT is a close-above-prior-high breakout plus a volume filter, which violates the explicit no failed-trigger-plus-filter constraint.
RANGE_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT is a close-above-prior-high breakout plus a range-expansion filter, which violates the same constraint.
The result omitted required per-candidate warmup, chart marker/overlay semantics, event-density risk, and explicit falsification details.
The proposed positivePct < 55% rejection rule is not a registered evidence metric contract and introduces an unsupported magic threshold.
